Research & Ethics

Research supervision

The brochure lists a Scientific & Research Advisory Committee supporting faculty, postgraduate and student research, dissertations and project review.

Ethical review

Institutional Ethics and Institutional Animal Ethics Committees are listed for the relevant forms of research review. Committee registration, membership and approval documents should be checked in the official records; no registration status is certified by this page.

Research outputs

The supplied brochure does not include a publication bibliography, grant list or dated project register. Those records are still needed to build a useful research archive.

Research and committee information→Existing college website→

Academic development

The Medical Education Unit described in the brochure supports faculty development and teaching methods. The curriculum and college council committees help coordinate academic planning.

Source: SVSMC College Information Brochure, version 1.2. Course availability, intake and policies should be checked against the current academic-year notices.
